sources.title: mmBERT: a Multilingual Modern Encoder through Adaptive Scheduling
sources.snippet: Our base version has the same number of non-embedding parameters as ModernBERT-base (110M) but a total of 307M parameters due to the larger vocabulary. mmBERT small has 140M total parameters, with 42M non-embedding parameters. As we show in (§ 4.5) these architectures are also significantly faster than any previous multilingual encoder model.
